column1: # Game profile of Persona 3 Portable (Switch, update 1.0.2). On Android it plays at 60 fps (as on the Switch) from a new game through the first school days
# to the first battle on April 9, with saves and Continue working, in handheld and console mode (a Galaxy S25 Edge and a Galaxy Z Flip 7, see README.md); the Mac has not run it yet
# Atlus's in-house engine with CRI middleware (P4G's), NVN, SDK 14.3.0. The provisional profile the survey made (dm/games/profile_guess.py),
# unchanged but for these comments. Shaders: 30 BNSH entries under sysdat.cpk, which the split's "other" packages hold (see README.md)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB − 148 MB of bss (counted as used memory): a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
